use_when.text: Start with one Header row, then Body rows with no gap.
Use Body Hover for the row under the pointer.
Keep the same column widths in every row.

dont_use_when.text: Do not round the rows. The Table container does the rounding.
Do not put more than one Header row in a table.

variant_intent.intent: Start with one Header row, then Body rows with no gap.
Start with one Header row, then Body rows with no gap.
Use Body Hover for the row under the pointer.

placement.text: Table: one Header row in thead, then five Body rows in tbody.
Header rows sit in a <thead> and Body rows in a <tbody> of a <table>.

pairs_with.how: Body rows: nested Status Badge in the Status column
Body rows: nested Link Button in the Action column, named "<Action> <Reference>"

a11y.text: Renders a <tr>. Header rows use <th scope="col"> cells; Body rows use <td> cells.
Body text cells carry a title attribute with the full value.
The Action Link Button gets aria-label "<Action> <Reference>", such as "Review LF-2041".
Use a table element: thead with th cells for the Header row, tbody with td cells for Body rows.
Give th cells scope="col", and give the table a caption or aria-label, such as "Recent reports".
The Review Link Button should be a link or button whose name includes the item, such as "Review LF-2041".
When cell text is cut off, show the full value on hover and on the item page.
Header labels are 6.1:1 on the green header. Body text is above 4.5:1.

gaps.detail: Table Row has no documentation page of its own; its entries are the rules on the Table documentation page (146:27), which holds the Table Row set that name Table Row or its variants. Rules written for the Table as a whole are not copied.
